sourceRefs.locator: Object data and Beschreibung, inventory 1989-0011-0769-9000. Mortised bed, wooden dowels and wedge, single bottom board, red and black decoration, leather and plant fibres, and gables added for the burial.
pp. 227–231, figs. 5, 6 and 9, n. 12. Waterlogged graves at the eastern farm, winter 703/704 felling date for freshly worked oak of grave 27, and the excavator’s dating of the burial to early 704.

labels.de: Das Bett aus Grab 27 von Mittelhofen

summary.de: Möbel mit eingeritztem Zirkeldekor und einem eingeschobenen Keil. Für die Beisetzung setzte man Giebelbretter an.
summary.en: A bed with compass-drawn ornament and a wedge in one joint. Gable boards were added when it was turned into a coffin.
